chunks: "Indeed, Allah, Blessed and Exalted, created the earth and commanded the whale, so it carried it. Then it said: 'I carried it by my strength.' So Allah, Mighty and Majestic, sent to it a whale the size of a fingertip, and it entered into its nostril, so it convulsed for forty mornings. Then, when Allah, Mighty and Majestic, wants to cause an earth to quake, that small whale appears to it, and the earth quakes out of fear."
And the earthquake may also occur by other than this manner.

key_terms.الزَّلْزَلَةُ: the earthquake; the phenomenon mentioned in the closing statement
key_terms.الْأَرْضَ: the earth; the created world discussed in the report
key_terms.الْحُوتَ: the whale; the creature described as bearing the earth
key_terms.بِقُوَّتِي: by my strength; an expression of attributed power in the narrative
key_terms.تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى: Blessed and Exalted; a formula glorifying Allah’s majesty and transcendence
key_terms.مَنْخِرِهَا: its nostril; the place where the smaller whale entered
key_terms.يُزَلْزِلَ: to cause to quake; referring to Allah causing an earthquake

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith describe the cause of earthquakes by the will of Allah?
ai.summary: This hadith presents a cosmological account in which the earth’s trembling occurs by Allah’s command through a created means. It emphasizes divine power over creation and shows that what appears mighty is still subdued by something smaller through Allah’s will.
